ec094092f4f94280806efccda08d43003f6cbd7c.sourceText: 标准库不会偷偷帮你自动 `join()`，因为自动等待可能让程序在一个意料之外的位置长时间阻塞；也不会偷偷 `detach()`，因为那可能制造更严重的生命周期错误。
ec094092f4f94280806efccda08d43003f6cbd7c.translatedText: The standard library will not secretly and automatically help you with `join()`, because automatic waiting may cause the program to block for a long time at an unexpected location; nor will it secretly `detach()`, because that could create more serious lifetime errors\.
